def native_cubic_smoke(size: int = 6) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Actual bit-packed primitive cubic graph and faithful six-Z carrier."""
    require(size >= 6, 'Native cubic minimum-six probe needs L>=6, not a ring')
    law = ImprovedPhiLaw(size)
    graph = FlavorPauliGraph(law, 1)
    spatial_set = set(graph.spatial_edges)
    generators = (*graph.B, *graph.A.values())
    cycles = (*graph.cycles, *graph.local_cycles)
    cycle_errors = sum(word.anticommutes(cycle) for word in generators for cycle in cycles)
    require(cycle_errors == 0, 'All actual primitive bilinears preserve statistical cycles')
    syndromes = [sum(((face.x >> edge)&1) << j for j, face in enumerate(graph.plaquettes)) for edge in graph.spatial_edges]

    require(len(star_edges) == 6, 'Actual spatial cubic star has six edges')
    star_mask = sum(1 << e for e in star_edges)
    joint_mask = star_mask | sum(1 << e for e in graph.incident[graph.mode(0, 0, 0)] if e in spatial_set)
    star = PauliWord(z=star_mask)
    joint = PauliWord(z=joint_mask)
    star_cubic_errors = sum(star.anticommutes(face) for face in graph.plaquettes)
    star_full_errors = sum(star.anticommutes(face) for face in graph.local_cycles)
    require(star_cubic_errors == 0 and star_full_errors > 0, 'Extra species constraints only reduce star support')
    require(not any(joint.anticommutes(face) for face in graph.local_cycles), 'Joint species star survives full local constraints')

    for axis in range(3):
        mask = 0
        for species in range(graph.species):
            for x, coord in enumerate(law.sites):

                    y = int(law.target[x, axis])
                    edge = graph.edge_index[tuple(sorted((graph.mode(species, x, 0), graph.mode(species, y, 0))))]
                    mask |= 1 << edge
        sheet = PauliWord(z=mask)
        local_errors = sum(sheet.anticommutes(face) for face in graph.local_cycles)
        body = tuple(graph.mode(1, law.index[tuple(j if a == axis else 0 for a in range(3))], 0) for j in range(size))
        winding_loop = graph.cycle(body)
        require(local_errors == 0 and sheet.anticommutes(winding_loop), 'Closed toron sheet flips winding but no local cycle')

    # diagonal P tests the actual plaquette syndrome of each subgroup element;
    # it retains the closed-star +/- occupation characters, not only one.
    dimension = 1 << 6
    localZ = []
    indices = np.arange(dimension)
    for bit in range(6):

        matrix[indices ^ (1 << bit), indices] = 1

    require(np.flatnonzero(keep).tolist() == [0, 63], 'Only empty/full six-star subsets are cubic-closed')
    P = np.diag(keep.astype(float))
    a = .13
    Zstar = np.linalg.multi_dot(localZ)
    exponential = expm(a*sum(localZ))

def matter_operator(one: np.ndarray,states):
    index={c:i for i,c in enumerate(states)}
    result=np.zeros((len(states),len(states)),complex)
    for j,c in enumerate(states):
        mask=sum(1<<x for x in c)
        for old in c:
            sign0=(-1)**sum(x<old for x in c);removed=mask^(1<<old)
            for new in range(8):
                if removed&(1<<new):continue
                sign=sign0*(-1)**((removed&((1<<new)-1)).bit_count())
                target=tuple(x for x in range(8) if (removed|(1<<new))&(1<<x))
                result[index[target],j]+=sign*one[new,old]
    return result


def native_current(gamma: np.ndarray,kappa: float,grid: int,space):
    epsilon=2e-4;jets=[]
    for theta in 2*math.pi*np.arange(grid)/grid:
        _,p0,h0,_,_=square_wilson(gamma,kappa,float(theta))
        _,pp,hp,_,_=square_wilson(gamma,kappa,float(theta+epsilon))
        _,pm,hm,_,_=square_wilson(gamma,kappa,float(theta-epsilon))
        current=matter_operator((hp-hm)/(2*epsilon),space['states'])-(math.log(pp)-math.log(pm))/(2*epsilon)*np.eye(len(space['states']))
        contact=matter_operator((hp+hm-2*h0)/epsilon**2,space['states'])-(math.log(pp)+math.log(pm)-2*math.log(p0))/epsilon**2*np.eye(len(space['states']))
        jets.append((current,contact))
    coeff=np.fft.fft(np.asarray(jets),axis=0)/grid
    answer=[]
    for order in range(2):
        matrix=np.array([[coeff[(n-m)%grid,order,i,j] for j,m,_ in space['physical']] for i,n,_ in space['physical']])
        check(bool(np.linalg.norm(matrix-matrix.conj().T)<1e-6),'Actual field/current/contact Fourier Hermiticity')
        answer.append(space['u'].conj().T@matrix@space['u'])
    return answer

def source_matrix(neutral,charged,coefficients: np.ndarray):
    """Integer dressed canonical a_plus†r or r†a_minus, charge1 Ref unchanged."""
    source=np.zeros((2*len(charged['physical']),len(neutral['physical'])),complex)

def positive_boundary_rayleigh(runtime: dict[str,Any],cut: float) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Same-lambda0 exact spectral estimate, with explicit K-null subtraction."""
    lc=runtime['charged_eigenvalues'];threshold=math.exp(-cut)
    raw=runtime['raw_source_purification'];ranged=runtime['range_source_purification']
    half=np.sqrt(lc)[:,None]*ranged
    M0=float(np.linalg.norm(raw,'fro')**2)
    M0range=float(np.linalg.norm(ranged,'fro')**2)
    M1=float(np.linalg.norm(half,'fro')**2)
    admitted=(lc>=threshold)&(lc<=1.)
    above=lc>1.
    # If charged K has spectrum above lambda0, subtract that contribution;
    # positivity alone never licenses treating it as PE[0,cut].
    upper_contribution=float(np.linalg.norm(half[above],'fro')**2)
    upper_raw=float(np.linalg.norm(ranged[above],'fro')**2)
    naive=M1-threshold*M0-upper_contribution
    sharper=M1-threshold*(M0range-upper_raw)-upper_contribution
    numerator=float(np.linalg.norm(half[admitted],'fro')**2)
    family=[np.sqrt(lc[admitted])[:,None]*v[admitted] for v in runtime['range_packet_purifications']]
    pe_gram=np.array([[np.vdot(a,b) for b in family] for a in family])
    above_family=[np.sqrt(lc[above]-threshold)[:,None]*v[above]
        for v in runtime['range_packet_purifications']]
    above_gram=np.array([[np.vdot(a,b) for b in above_family] for a in above_family])
    family_lower=runtime['boundary_packet_cross_Gram']-threshold*runtime['range_packet_cross_Gram']-above_gram
    family_residual=(pe_gram-family_lower)
    family_residual=(family_residual+family_residual.conj().T)/2
    family_residual_min=float(eigh(family_residual,eigvals_only=True)[0])
    check(family_residual_min>=-1e-10,'Actual whole coherent source family obeys spectral Gram Loewner inequality')
    check(abs(pe_gram.sum().real-numerator)<1e-10,'Wholepacket PE Gram retains every source cross term')
    check(numerator+1e-10>=max(naive,sharper),'Actual PE numerator obeys exact positiveK Rayleigh lower bound')
    check(abs(M1-runtime['source_retained_Gram'])<1e-10,'SameK charged halfstep/minor normalization')
    return dict(energy_cut=cut,neutral_lambda0=runtime['neutral_lambda0'],
        charged_threshold=runtime['neutral_lambda0']*threshold,
        raw_wholepacket_M0=M0,range_wholepacket_M0=M0range,
        exact_Knull_source_norm_squared=M0-M0range,positive_boundary_M1=M1,
        M1_over_raw_M0=M1/M0,M1_over_range_M0=M1/M0range,
        charged_above_neutral_lambda0_numerator=upper_contribution,
        raw_Rayleigh_PEGram_lower=naive,range_Rayleigh_PEGram_lower=sharper,
        actual_PEGram=numerator,wholepacket_PE_cross_Gram=pe_gram,
        sameK_wholepacket_PE_cross_Gram_lower_matrix=family_lower,
        sameK_cross_Gram_Loewner_residual_min=family_residual_min,
        actual_PE_cross_Gram_eigenvalues=eigh((pe_gram+pe_gram.conj().T)/2,eigvals_only=True),
        sameK_source_normalization=M1,PE_retention_probability=numerator/M1,
        sufficient_raw_Rayleigh_admission=naive>0,
        sufficient_range_Rayleigh_admission=sharper>0,
        observed_native_PE_admission=numerator>0,
        proof='K/lambda0=UUdag positive spectral factor; w=Sraw Xi_ph. Q=(0,K/lambda0<exp(-cut)) excludes exact K-null, so ||PE sqrt(K/lambda0)w||² >= M1-exp(-cut)||P_nonzero w||², after explicit subtraction of K/lambda0>1. Raw bound is weaker but valid. No inverse-log, source/PE commutation or charged own-max normalization.',
        numeric_scope='Observed double-precision canonical boundary-minor calculation with exact-arithmetic spectral inequality; not an interval-arithmetic enclosure or macro theorem.',
        macro_admission=False,finiteSCREEN_source_unchanged=True)

def native_toron(cutoff: int):

    raw=(F*weights)@F.conj().T;p=float(np.trace(raw).real);rho=raw/p
    exterior=np.eye(len(n))-R/math.pi*np.sinc(diff*R/math.pi)
    U=np.diag(np.exp(-1j*E*duration));evolved=U@rho@U.conj().T
    p2=float(weights@(n*n));bound2=duration**2*(63/(8*(beta*L)**2*R**4)+3*p2/((beta*L)**2*R**2))
    correct=float(E[cutoff+1]);wrong=1/(2*beta*L**3)

    check(abs(correct/wrong-L*L)<1e-12,'Holonomy kinetic uses beta L, not beta V')

        overlap_rows.append(dict(separation=separation,actual_reflected_overlap=overlap,
            continuum_overlap_over_Haar_probability=ratio,continuum_ratio_lower=lower))
    return dict(beta=beta,L=L,Nt=Nt,R=R,duration=duration,Fourier_cutoff=cutoff,
        trace=float(np.trace(rho).real),postselection_probability=p,exact_Haar_filter_probability=128*R/(315*math.pi),
        initial_Fourier_projection_leakage=float(np.trace(rho@exterior).real),evolved_outside_window_probability=float(np.trace(evolved@exterior).real),

        exact_continuum_filtered_momentum_second_moment=p2+3/R**2,

Fourier e^-x>=1-x and symmetric thermal n kill the cross nm term: E f_L f_R>=p[1-3ell/(2mR²)] in one toron, >=p3[1-9ell/(2mR²)] in three. This is scalar Cauchy plus actual heat overlap, not RN-to-OS positivity or an unproved cancellation of tiny p.',

def toron_static_response(p: Parameters,gamma: np.ndarray) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Measure actual canonical poles/projectors/jets below double precision."""
    with mp.workdps(130):
        Rh=mp.mpf('1e-50');L=p.spatial_size;T=p.time_slices
        _,frame=eigh(gamma[0]);frame=frame[:,::-1]
        transformed=np.array([frame.conj().T@g@frame for g in gamma])
        gammas=[mp.matrix([[mp.mpc(str(z.real),str(z.imag)) for z in row] for row in g]) for g in transformed]
        def point(momentum):
            b=mp.exp(mp.mpf('.01'))+sum(1-mp.cos(x) for x in momentum)
            F=sum((1j*gammas[j+1]*mp.sin(momentum[j]) for j in range(3)),mp.zeros(4))
            triangular=mp.eye(4)
            for a in range(2):
                for c in range(2):triangular[a,c+2]=-F[a,c+2]
            diagonal=mp.diag([1/b,1/b,b,b])
            one=triangular.H*diagonal*triangular
            values,vectors=mp.eighe(one);stable=vectors[:,:2]
            projector=stable*stable.H;currents=[];contacts=[]
            for axis in range(3):
                sine,cosine=mp.sin(momentum[axis]),mp.cos(momentum[axis])
                first=mp.zeros(4);second=mp.zeros(4)
                for a in range(2):
                    for c in range(2):
                        first[a,c+2]=-1j*gammas[axis+1][a,c+2]*cosine
                        second[a,c+2]=1j*gammas[axis+1][a,c+2]*sine
                d1=mp.diag([-sine/b**2]*2+[sine]*2)
                d2=mp.diag([2*sine*sine/b**3-cosine/b**2]*2+[cosine]*2)
                jet1=first.H*diagonal*triangular+triangular.H*d1*triangular+triangular.H*diagonal*first
                jet2=(second.H*diagonal*triangular+triangular.H*diagonal*second+
                    2*first.H*diagonal*first+2*first.H*d1*triangular+
                    2*triangular.H*d1*first+triangular.H*d2*triangular)
                j1=vectors.H*jet1*vectors;j2=vectors.H*jet2*vectors
                currents.append(mp.re(sum(-j1[s,s]/values[s] for s in range(2))/2))
                contact=mp.mpf(0)
                for s in range(2):
                    contact-=mp.re(j2[s,s])/values[s]/2
                    for t in range(4):
                        ratio=(values[t]-values[s])/values[s]
                        if abs(ratio)<mp.mpf('1e-20'):
                            divided=sum((-1)**n*ratio**(n-2)/n for n in range(2,20))/values[s]**2
                        else:divided=(-mp.log1p(ratio)+ratio)/(values[s]**2*ratio**2)
                        contact+=divided*abs(j1[s,t])**2
                contacts.append(contact)
            return values,stable,projector,currents,contacts

def finite_box_photon_partition(p: Parameters,cube_radius: int=64) -> dict[str,Any]:
    """Actual lattice dispersion sum with a positive finite-box tail bound."""
    L,Nt=p.spatial_size,p.time_slices
    n=np.arange(-cube_radius,cube_radius+1,dtype=float)
    s=np.sin(math.pi*n/L)**2
    energy=2*np.arcsinh(np.sqrt(s[:,None,None]+s[None,:,None]+s[None,None,:]))
    energy[cube_radius,cube_radius,cube_radius]=np.inf
    gamma=4*math.asinh(math.sqrt(3))/(3*L)
    start=cube_radius+1
    def positive_tail(tau):
        z=math.exp(-tau*gamma);d=1-z;a=start
        second=z**a*(a*a/d+2*a*z/d**2+z*(1+z)/d**3)
        zeroth=z**a/d
        return 2*(4*second+2*zeroth)/(1-z**a)
    finite_energy=np.where(np.isfinite(energy),energy,0.)
    def positive_energy_tail(tau):
        z=math.exp(-tau*gamma);d=1-z;a=start
        first=z**a*(a/d+z/d**2)
        third=z**a*(a**3/d+3*a*a*z/d**2+3*a*z*(1+z)/d**3+z*(1+4*z+z*z)/d**4)
        return 2*gamma*(4*third+2*first)/(1-z**a)
    rows=[]
    for fraction in (1.,.5,.75,.8,.85):
        tau=Nt*fraction
        central=float(-2*np.log1p(-np.exp(-tau*energy)).sum())
        tail=positive_tail(tau)
        guard=2**-30*(1+central+tail)
        mean_actual=float(2*np.sum(finite_energy/np.expm1(np.minimum(tau*energy,700))))
        mean_tail=positive_energy_tail(tau)
        rows.append(dict(inverse_temperature=tau,fraction=fraction,
            actual_finite_box_central_logZ=central,positive_omitted_box_logZ_upper=tail,
            rounding_guard=guard,logZ_lower=central-guard,logZ_upper=central+tail+guard,
            mean_energy_actual_central=mean_actual,mean_energy_positive_tail_upper=mean_tail,
            mean_energy_upper=mean_actual+mean_tail+2**-40))
    mean_central=rows[0]['mean_energy_actual_central']
    mean_tail=rows[0]['mean_energy_positive_tail_upper']
    mean_upper=rows[0]['mean_energy_upper']
    return dict(cube_radius=cube_radius,actual_nonzero_modes=(2*cube_radius+1)**3-1,
        physical_polarizations=2,rows=rows,mean_energy_actual_central=mean_central,
        mean_energy_positive_tail_upper=mean_tail,mean_energy_upper=mean_upper,
        dispersion='E(n)=2asinh(sqrt(sum sin²(pi n_j/L))) on the ACTUAL finite periodic box',
        tail_proof='E(n)>=gamma |n|1, gamma=4asinh(sqrt3)/(3L). Outside evaluated cube |n|1>=N+1; integer Z3 shell count4s²+2. Positive geometric moments bound all omitted finite-box modes by extending to infinite shells. No continuum thermal number or derivative of logZ upper used.',
        neutral_mass_normalization='ALL charged halfsteps retain the SAME neutral transfer lambda0; no charged-sector own-max rescale.')

    a: float = .01
    mass: float = 1.
    momentum: tuple[float, ...] = (.7, -.4, .3)
    native_cycle_penalty: float = 12.

def positive_log(matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    values, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(matrix)
    if values[0] <= 0:
        raise ArithmeticError('positive transfer required, not inverse Dirac matrix')
    return (vectors*np.log(values))@vectors.conj().T


def wilson_component_basis(gamma: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Fixed SU(4) reference embedding: (+gamma0, -gamma0) columns."""
    _, vectors = np.linalg.eigh(gamma[0])
    theta = np.concatenate((vectors[:, 2:], vectors[:, :2]), axis=1)
    return theta*np.exp(-.25j*np.angle(np.linalg.det(theta)))


def wilson_step(gamma: np.ndarray, a: float, mass: float,
                momentum: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, float]:
    consumer = WilsonConsumer(gamma, a, mass)
    b = 1+consumer.m0+float(np.sum(1-np.cos(momentum)))
    theta = wilson_component_basis(gamma)
    plus, minus = theta[:, :2], theta[:, 2:]
    f = plus.conj().T@(1j*np.einsum('j,jab->ab', np.sin(momentum), gamma[1:]))@minus
    l = np.block([[np.eye(2), -f], [np.zeros((2, 2)), np.eye(2)]])
    block = l.conj().T@np.diag([1/b, 1/b, b, b])@l
    return theta@block@theta.conj().T, b*b, consumer.energy(momentum)


def native_lift(model: BosonicEdgeModel, matrix: np.ndarray,
                offset: int = 0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Actual primitive even path polynomials, never an occupation isometry."""
    output = np.zeros_like(model.identity)
    anchor = offset
    for target, source in itertools.product(range(4), repeat=2):
        i, j = offset+target, offset+source
        if i == j:
            word = model.n(i)
        else:
            path = tuple(([j] if j != anchor else [])+[anchor]+([i] if i != anchor else []))
            word = model.bilinear(i, j, path=path)
        output += matrix[target, source]*word
    return output


def exterior(matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Independent finite comparator; never used to construct native transfer."""
    states = [tuple(i for i in range(4) if mask & (1 << i)) for mask in range(16)]
    out = np.zeros((16, 16), complex)
    for r, occupied_r in enumerate(states):
        for c, occupied_c in enumerate(states):
            if len(occupied_r) == len(occupied_c):
                out[r, c] = np.linalg.det(matrix[np.ix_(occupied_r, occupied_c)]) if occupied_r else 1.
    return out


def car_comparator() -> list[np.ndarray]:
    """Signs only for discriminating particle-hole algebra, not primitive law."""
    out = []
    for i in range(4):
        c = np.zeros((16, 16), complex)
        for mask in range(16):
            if mask & (1 << i):
                c[mask ^ (1 << i), mask] = (-1)**((mask & ((1 << i)-1)).bit_count())
        out.append(c)
    return out


def pairing_control(t: np.ndarray, gamma: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    theta = wilson_component_basis(gamma)
    # The particle/hole comparator uses eigenspace labels, not raw components.
    h = -theta.conj().T@positive_log(t)@theta
    c = car_comparator()
    p, antiparticle = c[:2], [c[j].conj().T for j in (2, 3)]
    ordinary = sum((h[i, j]*c[i].conj().T@c[j] for i, j in itertools.product(range(4), repeat=2)), np.zeros((16, 16), complex))
    paired = np.trace(h[2:, 2:])*np.eye(16, dtype=complex)
    for i, j in itertools.product(range(2), repeat=2):
        paired += h[i, j]*p[i].conj().T@p[j]
        paired -= h[2+i, 2+j]*antiparticle[j].conj().T@antiparticle[i]
        paired += h[i, 2+j]*p[i].conj().T@antiparticle[j].conj().T
        paired += h[2+j, i]*antiparticle[j]@p[i]
    number_p = sum((x.conj().T@x for x in p), np.zeros((16, 16), complex))
    number_a = sum((x.conj().T@x for x in antiparticle), np.zeros((16, 16), complex))
    charge = number_p-number_a
    dropped = paired.copy()
    for i, j in itertools.product(range(2), repeat=2):
        dropped -= h[i, 2+j]*p[i].conj().T@antiparticle[j].conj().T
        dropped -= h[2+j, i]*antiparticle[j]@p[i]
    return dict(particle_modes=2, antiparticle_modes=2,
                exact_particle_hole_pairing_identity_error=float(np.linalg.norm(ordinary-paired)),
                actual_pair_creation_block_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(h[:2, 2:])),
                charge_commutator=float(np.linalg.norm(paired@charge-charge@paired)),
                wrong_no_pairing_transfer_error=float(np.linalg.norm(expm(-dropped)-expm(-paired))),
                particle_plus_antiparticle_number_commutator=float(np.linalg.norm(paired@(number_p+number_a)-(number_p+number_a)@paired)),
                convention='p=c_plus, antiparticle=c_minus^dag; electric charge n_p-n_antiparticle=n_Dirac-2. Pair pdag adag plus adjoint is REQUIRED; Dirac number conservation does not imply excitation-number conservation.')


def native_case(p: RootParameters, gamma: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:

def phi_wilson_step(gamma: np.ndarray, kappa: float, momentum: tuple[float, ...],
                    remainder: np.ndarray, colour_links: tuple[np.ndarray, ...]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Physical-reference positive T; Bplus/Bminus remain eigenspace blocks."""
    theta = wilson_component_basis(gamma)
    plus, minus = theta[:, :2], theta[:, 2:]
    links = [expm(1j*p*np.eye(4))@u for p, u in zip(momentum, colour_links)]
    b = np.eye(4)/(2*kappa)-sum((u+u.conj().T for u in links), np.zeros((4, 4), complex))/2
    b += kappa*remainder[0]+kappa*np.linalg.norm(remainder)**2*np.eye(4)
    bp, bm = plus.conj().T@b@plus, minus.conj().T@b@minus
    c = sum((g@u-u.conj().T@g for g, u in zip(gamma[1:], links)), np.zeros((4, 4), complex))/2
    c += kappa*remainder[0]+kappa*sum((y@u-u.conj().T@y for y, u in zip(remainder[1:], links)), np.zeros((4, 4), complex))/2
    f = plus.conj().T@c@minus
    l = np.block([[np.eye(2), -f], [np.zeros((2, 2)), np.eye(2)]])
    block = l.conj().T@np.block([[np.linalg.inv(bp), np.zeros((2, 2))],
                               [np.zeros((2, 2)), bm]])@l
    return theta@block@theta.conj().T, bp, bm


def nonclifford_chart_native(gamma: np.ndarray, photon: Parameters) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Explicit noncommuting colour/normal positive completion, no global gamma."""

    generators = matrix_unit_basis()
    tangent = np.column_stack([(1j*np.array([g@x-x@g for x in phi])).reshape(-1) for g in generators])
    real_tangent = np.vstack((tangent.real, tangent.imag))
    candidate = np.array([sum((math.sin((mu+1)*(j+1))*g for j, g in enumerate(generators)), np.zeros((4, 4), complex)) for mu in range(4)], dtype=complex)
    vector = candidate.reshape(-1)
    real_vector = np.concatenate((np.real(vector), np.imag(vector)))
    normal = real_vector-real_tangent@np.linalg.lstsq(real_tangent, real_vector, rcond=None)[0]
    normal *= 1e-5/np.linalg.norm(normal)
    y = (normal[:64]+1j*normal[64:]).reshape(4, 4, 4)
    identity_links = (np.eye(4), np.eye(4), np.eye(4))
    colour = expm(.03j*sum((math.sin(j+1)*g for j, g in enumerate(generators)), np.zeros((4, 4), complex)))
    kappa = 1/(2*(math.expm1(.01)+4))
    t, bp, bm = phi_wilson_step(gamma, kappa, (.3, .2, .1), y, (colour, *identity_links[1:]))
    t0, _, _ = phi_wilson_step(gamma, kappa, (.3, .2, .1), np.zeros_like(y), (colour, *identity_links[1:]))
    arbitrary = phi+y
    normalized = arbitrary/np.sqrt(np.einsum('mij,mji->m', arbitrary, arbitrary).real/4)[:, None, None]
    naive = np.array([normalized[0]]+[1j*normalized[0]@normalized[j] for j in (1, 2, 3)])
    defect = max(float(np.linalg.norm(naive[i]@naive[j]+naive[j]@naive[i]-(2*np.eye(4) if i == j else 0)))
                 for i, j in itertools.product(range(4), repeat=2))
    return dict(actual_normal_coordinate_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(y)),
                actual_normal_tangent_inner_error=float(np.linalg.norm(real_tangent.T@normal)),
                actual_noncommuting_colour_gamma0=float(np.linalg.norm(colour@gamma[0]-gamma[0]@colour)),

                actual_gauge_dependent_prefactor=float(np.linalg.det(bp).real),

def centre_current_native(gamma: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Actual Z4 Gauss link states, cycle coherence and Wilson centre branches."""
    assignments = list(itertools.product(range(4), repeat=3))
    edges = ((0, 1), (1, 2), (0, 2))
    def divergence(q: tuple[int, ...]) -> np.ndarray:
        result = np.zeros(3, dtype=int)
        for value, (source, target) in zip(q, edges):
            result[source] += value
            result[target] -= value
        return result % 4
    def packet(n: np.ndarray, tree_only: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
        allowed = np.array([np.array_equal(divergence(q), n % 4) and (not tree_only or q[2] == 0)
                            for q in assignments], float)
        return allowed/math.sqrt(float(allowed@allowed))
    charge = np.array([1, 2, 1])
    state = packet(charge)
    moved_charge = charge.copy()
    moved_charge[0] -= 1
    moved_charge[2] += 1
    # Physical 0->2 current shifts the ACTUAL chord character q02 by -1.
    shift = np.zeros((64, 64), complex)
    for column, q in enumerate(assignments):
        moved = (*q[:2], (q[2]-1) % 4)
        shift[assignments.index(moved), column] = 1
    coherent_overlap = abs(np.vdot(packet(moved_charge), shift@state))
    tree_overlap = abs(np.vdot(packet(moved_charge, True), shift@packet(charge, True)))
    wrong = packet((-charge) % 4)
    wrong_gauss = max(abs(1j**int(charge[x]-divergence(q)[x])-1)
                      for amplitude, q in zip(wrong, assignments) if amplitude for x in range(3))
    # Actual Fourier transform of all cycle characters annihilates nonflat
    # centre holonomy. Tree packets alone do NOT perform this projection.
    fourier = np.array([[1j**sum(qi*zi for qi, zi in zip(q, z))/8
                         for q in assignments] for z in assignments])
    centre_state = fourier@state
    nonflat = np.array([(z[0]+z[1]-z[2]) % 4 != 0 for z in assignments])
    uncorrelated = fourier@packet(charge, True)
    _, basis = np.linalg.eigh(gamma[0])
    gpm = basis[:, 2:].conj().T@gamma[1]@basis[:, :2]
    def step(phases: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        transport = np.zeros((3, 3), complex)
        for x in range(3):
            transport[x, (x+1) % 3] = phases[x]
        b = np.kron(np.eye(2), (2+math.expm1(.01))*np.eye(3)-(transport+transport.conj().T)/2)
        f = np.kron(gpm, (transport-transport.conj().T)/2)
        l = np.block([[np.eye(6), -f], [np.zeros((6, 6)), np.eye(6)]])
        return l.conj().T@np.block([[np.linalg.inv(b), np.zeros((6, 6))],
                                  [np.zeros((6, 6)), b]])@l
    baseline = step(np.ones(3))
    covariance = 0.
    wrong_pole = 0.
    for z in itertools.product(range(4), repeat=3):
        g = 1j**np.array(z)
        phase = g*np.conj(np.roll(g, -1))
        transform = np.kron(np.eye(4), np.diag(g))
        transported = step(phase)
        covariance = max(covariance, float(np.linalg.norm(transported-transform@baseline@transform.conj().T)))
        unadjusted = phase.copy()
        unadjusted[-1] = 1
        wrong_pole = max(wrong_pole, float(np.linalg.norm(np.linalg.eigvalsh(step(unadjusted))-np.linalg.eigvalsh(baseline))))
    return dict(actual_centre_quantum_Hilbert=64, Gauss_cycle_packet_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(state)),
                actual_chord_current_overlap=coherent_overlap,
                wrong_fixed_tree_current_overlap=tree_overlap,
                wrong_subtree_sign_Gauss_phase_error=float(wrong_gauss),
                actual_nonflat_centre_flux_probability=float(np.linalg.norm(centre_state[nonflat])**2),
                wrong_uncorrelated_tree_chord_flux_probability=float(np.linalg.norm(uncorrelated[nonflat])**2),
                actual_ALL64_centre_branch_Wilson_transfer_covariance_error=covariance,
                wrong_unadjusted_chord_Wilson_pole_spectrum_error=wrong_pole,
                convention='Orient root->child: n_x+q_in-sum q_out=0; hence q_tree=-sum_subtree n. Sum coherently over ALL divergence-compatible q assignments, including every cycle. Fourier support is centre-flat pure gauge, NOT independent four-peaked links.')

        t, prefactor, _ = wilson_step(gamma, 1., pole_mass, np.array([.3+node, .2, .1]))
        blocks.append(prefactor*exterior(t))

    spatial_syndromes = tuple(tuple(i for i, face in enumerate(graph.plaquettes)
                                  if (face.x >> edge) & 1)
                             for edge in graph.spatial_edges)
    if any(len(syndrome) != 4 for syndrome in spatial_syndromes) or len(set(spatial_syndromes)) != len(graph.spatial_edges):
        raise ArithmeticError('Actual cubic spatial defects have zero/duplicate plaquette syndromes')

                               gamma: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    consumer = WilsonConsumer(gamma, p.a, p.mass)
    cases = []

        momentum = math.pi*np.array(history)/photon.spatial_size

        step, _, _ = wilson_step(gamma, p.a, p.mass, momentum)

                          actual_spin_multiplicity=spinors.shape[1],
